description: Get IPOSignal's X/Twitter social-sentiment reading for a specific IPO — an aggregate of how investors are discussing the stock on X, scored from -1 (bearish) to +1 (bullish) with a label, post tallies, and a one-line summary. The reading is taken once, before listing, and not refreshed: `ageDays` says how old it is and `reliable` is false when too few posts back it. Returns the aggregate signal only, not the underlying posts. Provide exactly one of companyId, symbol, or cik. PREMIUM: paid per call over x402 (USDC on Base); an unpaid call returns the payment terms, and a not-found is never charged. Same data and price as the HTTP endpoint /api/agent/social-sentiment.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, with or without leading zeros, e.g. 1876042 or 0001876042.

companyId.description: IPOSignal company id (24-character hex), as returned by other IPOSignal responses.

symbol.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. CRCL. Case-insensitive. Tickers get reassigned, so a response may carry a symbolNote.

name: get_ipo_social_sentiment

ageDays.description: Whole days since analyzedAt. Readings are taken in the days before listing and not refreshed, so an old reading is the pre-IPO mood.

analyzedAt.description: When the posts were read, ISO 8601.

company.description: Registrant name as filed with the SEC, e.g. Circle Internet Group, Inc.

postCount.description: How many posts on X the reading is based on.

reliable.description: False when too few posts back the reading: one post can set the label.

score.description: -1 (all posts bearish) to +1 (all posts bullish), across the posts read.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol the company trades under now, upper case, e.g. CRCL.

currentHolderCik.description: CIK of the company that holds the ticker today, when known.

currentHolderName.description: Name of the company that holds the ticker today, when known.

servedCik.description: CIK of the company whose record this response holds.

symbolNote.description: Present only when the ticker you asked for has belonged to more than one company and the record served is not the current holder's. Absent on an ordinary lookup.

title: IPO social sentiment (premium)
